description: This file defines the LibraryFragment class for an Android music player app. It manages permissions and loads songs to display in a RecyclerView.

classes.name: LibraryFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays the user's music library and handles permissions.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, initializes RecyclerView, and checks permissions.

methods.name: checkAndRequestPermission
methods.description: Checks the required permissions and requests them if necessary.

methods.name: loadSongs
methods.description: Loads all songs via SongLoader and sets up the adapter.
